Players Committee card image of [[The Force Is Strong With This One (V)]] (original printing), game text: “If your padawan or Skywalker of ability < 6 is in battle with a Dark Jedi, either add one battle destiny or cancel I Have You Now.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/theforceisstrongwiththisone.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
